_comment: Assets 3D a gerar com o Tripo (texto -> modelo). A ordem e a prioridade: impacto visual por credito. Nada aqui contem a chave da API (ela vem de TRIPO_API_KEY). Tamanhos em metros no mundo do jogo; frente do modelo no jogo = +Z, origem no centro da base. 'replaces' sao os tipos que o mundo troca (ver src/world/models.js).
style: heavily weathered abandoned 1990s Brazilian public psychiatric hospital equipment, decayed and filthy, peeling paint, rust, grime and old stains, cold desaturated grey-green color palette, realistic proportions, horror game prop, single object, isolated on a plain background, no floor, no shadow
negative: cartoon, stylized, toy, bright saturated colors, clean, brand new, glossy plastic, text, logo, watermark, multiple objects, ground, floor, platform, base, background, people, hands, low poly

assets.why: 15 camas (enfermaria e ala de pacientes): o objeto mais repetido e iconico do jogo; hoje e so tubos e uma caixa
assets.prompt: Old metal hospital bed with a thin stained mattress and a crumpled dirty grey sheet, rusty tubular steel frame with bars at the head and at the foot, small caster wheels, three quarter view

assets.why: aparece nos corredores, subsolo e alas; a cadeira de rodas atual e um conjunto de aros e caixas
assets.prompt: Abandoned old hospital wheelchair, rusted chrome frame, torn black vinyl seat and backrest with exposed foam, two large rear wheels with push rims, two small front caster wheels, folding footrests

assets.why: macas do necrotério e do depósito de corpos (e sorteadas nos corredores)
assets.prompt: Flat hospital stretcher gurney trolley, a perfectly horizontal flat thin worn vinyl mattress pad lying level on a stainless steel frame, long rectangular shape about two meters long and seventy centimeters wide, four swivel wheels, low side rails, no raised backrest, scratched and stained, empty
assets._nota: a 1a versao (so 'old hospital stretcher...') veio com o encosto levantado como cadeira: curta, alta e o corpo atravessaria o encosto; esta e a 2a geracao. fit exact: o modelo e baixo e curto; estica altura e comprimento quase igual (rodas continuam redondas de lado). overlayY = altura do colchao do modelo (0,62) - 0,86 do prop procedural

assets.why: o corpo coberto nas macas hoje e feito de elipsoides lisos: a forma sob o lencol e o que mais pesa no susto do necrotério
assets.prompt: Corpse lying flat on its back completely covered by a thin stained off white cloth sheet, only the human body shape under the cloth, head shoulders chest hips and legs, bare feet sticking out at the end with a paper toe tag. Lying directly on the ground, no stretcher, no table, no bed, no furniture, no base, no pedestal
assets.style_override: heavily weathered abandoned 1990s Brazilian public psychiatric hospital morgue prop, decayed and filthy, old stains, cold desaturated grey-green color palette, realistic proportions, horror game prop, single object, isolated on a plain background, no floor, no shadow
assets._nota: a 1a versao ('...stained off white hospital sheet... morgue') veio com uma maca embutida (corpo sobre maca, minusculo); esta e a 2a geracao, sem base. Mais larga que um corpo real: fit exact para esticar o comprimento

assets.why: peca central da sala de autopsia (2 mesas)
assets.prompt: Long flat stainless steel morgue autopsy table, a very long and narrow rectangular tabletop about two meters long and seventy centimeters wide, perfectly flat and horizontal with a slightly raised rim, one drain hole at the foot end, standing on a simple single column pedestal base, table height about ninety centimeters, scratched dull steel with old brown stains, empty, no body, no tilt
assets._nota: a 1a versao ('...raised edges and a drain hole, single column pedestal...') saiu com o tampo inclinado e curto (1,09 m): nao serve para o corpo sobreposto; esta e a 2a geracao. O modelo e baixo (L:A = 3,6:1): fit exact estica so a altura (pedestal liso)

assets.why: Ala Noturna: a cadeira de contencao e o objeto mais macabro do subsolo
assets.prompt: Antique asylum restraint chair made of dark wood and rusty iron, high back, thick leather straps with buckles for wrists ankles and chest, a metal headrest clamp, grimy
Medical IV drip stand pole with a five leg wheeled base and a hook crossbar holding an empty cloudy IV fluid bag with a thin tube, old rusty chrome, dusty

assets.why: carrinho da enfermaria (instrumentos sobre o tampo)
assets.prompt: Tall narrow hospital instrument trolley, vertical proportions, about ninety centimeters tall and only about sixty centimeters long and forty five wide, two stainless steel shelves with raised rims, a push handle on one short end, four small swivel caster wheels, a few dusty surgical instruments and an old kidney tray on the top shelf, rusty and stained
assets._nota: a 1a versao ('Old rusty medical instrument trolley cart...') saiu baixa e comprida (0,56 m): os itens do jogo ficam a 0,855 m em cima do carrinho e flutuariam; esta e a 2a geracao. Escala uniforme para a bandeja (0,6 no modelo) ficar a 0,855 m: sobra ~0,14 m por ponta alem da pegada de colisao 0,66 (grow 1,45); res.top e as superficies nao mudam (servidor identico)
